name: Anonymous user reads public catalog metadata via sanitized view
evidence: View public_available_content created with security_barrier=true and granted to anon. Client queries public_available_content.

name: Anonymous user cannot read private video sources or raw playback URLs
evidence: video_sources table access explicitly revoked from anon role. View strictly excludes playback_url and provider_asset_id.

name: Anonymous user cannot read internal license records or documents
evidence: license_rights table revoked from anon. Public view projects zero internal licensing columns.

name: Anonymous user cannot read admin profiles
evidence: admin_profiles access revoked from anon; RLS restricts read/write exclusively to verified super_admin role.

name: Anonymous user cannot read audit logs
evidence: audit_logs access revoked from anon and gated behind is_super_admin() security definer.

name: Anonymous user cannot mutate or publish/unpublish content
evidence: All DML rights on movies, video_sources, and public_available_content revoked from anonymous role.

name: Unauthorized authenticated user cannot perform admin operations
evidence: Server-side is_super_admin() check and client-side post-auth verification prevent non-admin authenticated users from accessing admin operations.

name: Authorized Super Admin can perform permitted operations
evidence: Comprehensive admin_all_* RLS policies grant full access to verified Super Admin users across all 12 tables.

name: Expired admin sessions are rejected and purged
evidence: auth.js evaluates expiresAt timestamp in both loadSession() and isAuthenticated(), calling logout() on expired sessions.

name: Supabase connection failure fails closed without insecure bypass
evidence: Arbitrary password bypass completely removed. System fails closed with an explicit error when Supabase is disconnected.

name: TMDB private API key is strictly absent from all frontend source files
evidence: Zero hardcoded TMDB API keys found across all frontend files. Edge function securely injects TMDB_API_KEY from backend environment secrets.

name: Playback authorization does not reveal private sources before explicit authorization
evidence: Edge Function returns 403 with { authorized: false, reason: "..." } without exposing private source URLs or license details.
